grades.raw_answer: Shuffle assets, demands, events and investments separately; split/shuffle actions into five type decks. Draw a setup card and place its listed components in its districts; place its specified number of facedown assets one per turn slot from slot 1. Set round 1 and resources 0, reveal a demand and set targets. Players choose corporations with matching sheet/emergency; use four-player sides at four players, five/six sides otherwise (Melange unchanged). Randomly select first player: 10 capital, then clockwise 11, 12, etc.; threat 0. Deal one secret rival per player from participating corporations plus Federalist; extra stays facedown under board. Each draws two investments, keeps one facedown, returns the other facedown to top.
